title: the discovered shim leaves the heartbeat
intention: DiscoveredShim and its _FeedbackDevice leave the heartbeat: cairn/devices/cairn/machines/ground_loop/discovered.py moves to cairn/tools/base/discovered.py, and every importer reaches it there.
why: Measured 2026-11-09: encapsulation_breaches reds cairn/tools/bus_client/roster.py:67 and cairn/tools/data_recorder/proofs/test_reading_declaration.py:193 for importing cairn.devices.cairn.machines.ground_loop.discovered, and outline 5.6.3 says ground_loop must never grow back a shim. The module imports only cairn.tools.base, and nothing in ground_loop outside its proofs imports it.
traces_to: RULE 1 (a tool reaching into a device's code), outline 5.6.3, ticket 8e3474a6ae43 (clear the cross-device reaches).
how: git mv the module unchanged, point the five importers at cairn.tools.base.discovered, move the mailbox proof with what it measures, fix both charters' public_interface.

clauses.claim: cairn/tools/base/discovered.py defines DiscoveredShim and _FeedbackDevice, and cairn/devices/cairn/machines/ground_loop/discovered.py does not exist
no .py file in the repo names cairn.devices.cairn.machines.ground_loop.discovered
encapsulation_breaches has no row whose module is cairn.devices.cairn.machines.ground_loop.discovered
cairn/tools/base's public_interface lists cairn.tools.base.discovered, and ground_loop's lists neither the discovered nor the loop module

decisions.text: D1: git mv cairn/devices/cairn/machines/ground_loop/discovered.py cairn/tools/base/discovered.py, bytes unchanged. In cairn/tools/base/mail_probe.py line 4 the docstring '(ground_loop/discovered.py)' becomes '(tools/base/discovered.py)'.

D2: replace 'from cairn.devices.cairn.machines.ground_loop.discovered import' with 'from cairn.tools.base.discovered import' at cairn/tools/bus_client/roster.py:67, cairn/tools/data_recorder/proofs/test_reading_declaration.py:193, cairn/devices/cairn/machines/bus/proofs/test_delivery.py:47 and cairn/devices/cairn/machines/ground_loop/proofs/test_discovery.py:141.

D3: git mv cairn/devices/cairn/machines/ground_loop/proofs/test_a_mailbox_nobody_reads_keeps_nothing.py cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_a_mailbox_nobody_reads_keeps_nothing.py (it measures only _FeedbackDevice); in it, line 18 parents[6] becomes parents[4] and line 34's importlib string becomes 'cairn.tools.base.discovered'. git rm cairn/devices/cairn/machines/ground_loop/validations/test_a_mailbox_nobody_reads_keeps_nothing.json; the proof is sealed fresh at its new address.

D4: through the artifact door, cairn/tools/base/intention+why.json's public_interface gains 'cairn.tools.base.discovered' (after cairn.tools.base.diagnostic); cairn/devices/cairn/machines/ground_loop/intention+why.json's public_interface drops 'cairn.devices.cairn.machines.ground_loop.discovered' and 'cairn.devices.cairn.machines.ground_loop.loop' (deleted by efb670ff1dd8), keeping discovery.

D5: the proof cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_the_discovered_shim_is_a_base_tool.py, red-first, one tooth per clause, PROVES 2438292fae7c 1 to 4, with a __main__ runner printing PASS/FAIL per tooth. Tooth 3 calls encapsulation_breaches from cairn/machines/build_inspector/inspector.py.

FIXME 1: The PROVED gate's every_class_reaches_the_diagnostic_mixin lane reds ground_loop, the owning component: in cairn/devices/cairn/machines/ground_loop/discovery.py, line 112 'class ProbeCache:' becomes 'class ProbeCache(DiagnosticBase):', and after line 52 (from cairn.tools.base.probe import Probe) add 'from cairn.tools.base.diagnostic import DiagnosticBase'. DiagnosticBase's __init__ is cooperative, so ProbeCache() is unchanged. Then reseal cairn/devices/cairn/machines/ground_loop/proofs/test_discovery.py. Retiring discovery.py itself (outline 5.6.3) is its own ticket: modules in cairn/tools/base still reach it by string.

D7: D1 and D3 are already built at 784669a7: cairn/tools/base/discovered.py and cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_a_mailbox_nobody_reads_keeps_nothing.py stand and the old ground_loop paths are gone; on this FIXME pass there is nothing to git mv, only the FIXME 1 decision (D6) to build.

out: ground_loop's shim.py and discovery.py (outline 5.6.3 names them too; their own tickets)
every other reach in the census
